boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Arlington
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented UTA spaces for studying, making, gathering, recreation, and attending campus events.

cards.title: E.H. Hereford University Center
cards.subtitle: UTA’s student-life hub
cards.notes: Use the lounges as a meeting point between classes, or check the event rooms and campus services before planning a group gathering.
cards.short_summary: A central building combining lounge space, dining, services, and event rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA identifies the University Center as its main hub of student life and says its lounge areas support studying, meeting peers, and breaks.
cards.source_title: University Center - Student Centers - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Building services and individual venues may have separate hours or reservation requirements.

cards.title: The Commons study lounges
cards.subtitle: West side of the UTA campus
cards.notes: Settle into open lounge seating for collaborative work, or reserve a private quiet room through the university’s linked booking service.
cards.short_summary: A West Campus student center with open lounges and reservable quiet rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA states that The Commons has open lounge seating and private quiet rooms for focused study, collaboration, and academic success.
cards.source_title: The Commons - Student Centers - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Private study rooms are booked through Skedda; check availability before relying on one.

cards.title: Brazos Park amphitheater lawn
cards.subtitle: University Center Mall
cards.notes: Meet on the lawn or watch for campus programming at the amphitheater; student organizations should use MavEngage for space reservations.
cards.short_summary: A lawn and amphitheater designed for campus gatherings and programmed events.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA describes Brazos Park as a meeting, collaboration, and celebration space with an amphitheater, and lists traditional events held there.
cards.source_title: Brazos Park - Student Centers - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Event space and equipment require reservation through the applicable university process.

cards.title: Central Library’s six floors
cards.subtitle: UTA Libraries
cards.notes: Choose an individual or group-study area, then use the library’s study-room information when your project needs a reservable workspace.
cards.short_summary: UTA’s largest library facility offers study spaces across six floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA reports that Central Library has individual and group study spaces throughout its six floors.
cards.access_notes: Study-room use and library access are governed by current UTA Libraries policies.

cards.title: UTA FabLab
cards.subtitle: Central Library
cards.notes: Bring a project idea, then check the FabLab’s training and equipment guidance before planning a build, print, cut, or other fabrication session.
cards.short_summary: An 8,000-square-foot Central Library makerspace for creative and technical work.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA identifies the Central Library FabLab as an 8,000-square-foot makerspace with fabrication equipment and training opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Equipment use, training, and access requirements may apply.

cards.title: Maverick Activities Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation’s MAC
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the published facility schedule, and check the recreation page for availability of courts, climbing, or other areas.
cards.short_summary: UTA’s campus recreation facility, with activity areas and posted operating schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA’s MAC facility page publishes operating hours and identifies recreation areas including courts, a climbing wall, and net activities.
cards.source_title: MAC - Campus Recreation - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Hours and area availability can change for special events; review the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: College Park Center
cards.subtitle: 600 S. Center St.
cards.notes: Check the university event calendar for a game, lecture, or other listed program, and confirm event-specific entry details before you go.
cards.short_summary: UTA’s special-events arena hosts Maverick basketball, volleyball, and other programs.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA says College Park Center regularly hosts basketball and volleyball games, concerts, lectures, commencements, and other events.
cards.source_title: College Park District - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Admission, seating, and schedules depend on the specific event.

cards.title: The Green at College Park
cards.subtitle: Next to College Park Center
cards.notes: Use the lawn and curved stone-wall seating for a low-key outdoor pause, then leave the space ready for the next campus or community group.
cards.short_summary: A 4.62-acre gathering green beside the arena, with lawn, native plantings, and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA describes The Green at College Park as a gathering and relaxation space with a large lawn, native grasses, adaptive plants, and curved stone-wall seating.
cards.source_title: Things to Do — College Park District - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and scheduled activities may affect use.

cards.title: UTA Planetarium
cards.subtitle: Chemistry & Physics Building, 700 Planetarium Place
cards.notes: Look up the current public-show schedule, then use the university’s parking and access guidance when planning a visit to the dome.
cards.short_summary: A campus planetarium with a 60-foot dome and public-show visitor information.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA states that its Planetarium is in the Chemistry & Physics Building at 700 Planetarium Place and provides public-show visitor guidance.
cards.source_title: Visiting the UTA Planetarium - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Public-show schedules, tickets, parking, and construction-related access are subject to current planetarium guidance.

cards.title: Architecture Courtyard
cards.subtitle: UTA outdoor campus venue
cards.notes: Use this named courtyard as a campus meetup location, and follow Student Organizations guidance if your group needs to reserve it for an event.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor venue included in UTA’s student-organization campus venue list.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA lists Architecture Courtyard among its general outdoor campus spaces for student-organization venue planning.
cards.source_title: Campus Venues - Student Organizations - The University of Texas at Arlington
cards.access_notes: Student organizations must register events and coordinate reservations with the managing department.
